import.fileNewer: Not imported from the old version: {{file}} was written by a newer version
import.fileInvalid: Not imported from the old version: {{file}} is damaged
import.locked: Data of the old version could not be decrypted: {{count}}. Servers and passwords that need it were not imported; add them again
import.leftovers: Unencrypted copies of your data are still in the old version's folder: {{files}}. Delete them once you no longer need the old version
import.retry: Could not read or save: {{files}}. The import runs again at the next start
import.softMode: Hard mode works only when the app is started as administrator, so the imported settings use Soft mode
import.strictNeedsAdmin: The strict kill switch was kept, but it works only when the app is started as administrator. To connect without these rights, choose another level in the settings
import.subscriptionPending: The subscription of the old version was added: its servers appear after the group's first refresh
